designationHistory.indexText: Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge was established in 2002 under the Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge Establishment Act of 2000.

authority.citation: Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge Establishment Act, Public Law 106-331 (Oct. 19, 2000)

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Public Law 106-331, Oct. 19, 2000 (govinfo): "To provide for the establishment of the Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge"

USFWS, Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (508 Compliant) (ServCat 167938): "Cahaba River NWR was established in 2002 under the authority of The Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge Establishment Act, Public Law No. 106-331, passed on October 19, 2000"

review.note: Draft signer George W. Bush is wrong: the establishing act was signed by Clinton (Oct. 19, 2000); the refuge came into being in 2002 on first acquisition. The day (Sept. 25, 2002) comes only from the FWS page.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Cahaba River National Wildlife Refuge was established September 25, 2002 for the purpose of protecting and managing a unique section of the Cahaba River and land adjacent to it.

historySource: Refuge About Us pages, fws.gov (draft, pending review)
